errors.description: Worst framing of the group. The model's head is cropped off above the chin and BOTH shoulders run off the left and right frame edges, so neither shoulder end point nor either sleeve head is in the picture.
errors.expected: Frame WIDE so both ends of the shoulder sit inside the picture with clear background beyond each; a shoulder is judged at its END POINT.
errors.actual: A chest-and-lapel crop. What dominates the frame is the notch lapel, the tie, the buttoning point and the flap pockets — every one of them a different craft option's subject.

errors.description: The extended, roped English shoulder cannot be shown at all. Roping is by definition read at the shoulder end where the sleeve head rises above the shoulder line, and that exact point is outside the crop on both sides.
errors.expected: Extended and roped shoulder line with large padding, giving an almost martial appearance.
errors.actual: Shoulder ends unphotographed; the visible upper chest reads soft if anything.

errors.description: CATALOG DATA DEFECT, not an image defect: this option's label and description say THE STRUCTURED / ENGLISH SHOULDER with large padding and a roped shoulder, but its required tokens say padding 'unpadded' and insertion 'rolled (con rollino)'. Those are opposite constructions. Worse, suit-2pc/sleeve-shirt-head (THE UNSTRUCTURED / ITALIAN SHOULDER) carries IDENTICAL required tokens — unpadded + rolled — so the two opposing options are specified the same way and no image can satisfy both checklists distinguishably.
errors.expected: Structured English shoulder should specify padded/roped; the Italian shoulder should specify unpadded/spalla camicia.
errors.actual: Both options specify unpadded + rolled (con rollino). One of the two specs is wrong at source.

errors.description: The reference file is a website UI screenshot rather than a clean tech pack: public/images/jacket/shoulder-head/regular.jpg shows the line art inside a bordered selection card with a blue selected-state checkmark badge and a 'Regular' caption below it.
errors.expected: A clean tech-pack drawing with no interface chrome.
errors.actual: Card border, blue checkmark and caption text surround the drawing. The garment line art inside is legible and does depict the shoulder/sleeve, so it is usable, but the chrome is contamination risk for any future attempt.

notes: Graded candidate-7 (attempt 7 of 7 already on disk; no credits spent this session).
